description.value: Green Point Day Use Area sits on the shore of Harrison Lake within Sasquatch Provincial Park, roughly six kilometres north of Harrison Hot Springs off Highway 7. The site offers access to Harrison Lake's rocky beach for swimming, though the lake can be cool and subject to high winds. It is part of a park known for pocket lakes, second-growth birch forest, hiking trails, and wildlife viewing.

OSM tags are minimal (leisure=nature_reserve, name only), providing no additional amenity evidence. All amenity fields must therefore remain null due to absence of evidence.
